name: Google Antigravity
summary: Google's agent-first development platform and IDE built around Gemini models.
description: Google Antigravity is an agentic development platform in which AI agents plan, write and verify code across the editor, terminal and browser. It is generally available, and it also reaches other IDEs through extensions; Google has moved the free tier of Gemini CLI to its Antigravity CLI. Individuals can use it for $0 per month. Business Standard and Plus plans start at $30 per seat per month, with a pay-as-you-go option.

howToUse.title: Open Google Antigravity
howToUse.description: Go to Google Antigravity and choose Download. The desktop build is listed for macOS, Windows, and Linux. It is an agentic development platform, and it is generally available.

howToUse.title: Let agents write and verify code
howToUse.description: Have agents plan, write, and verify code across the editor, terminal, and browser. The page also lists the Antigravity IDE, the Antigravity CLI, and extensions that reach other IDEs.

howToUse.title: Choose an individual or business price
howToUse.description: Individuals can use it for $0 per month. Business Standard and Plus plans start at $30 per seat per month, with a pay-as-you-go option. Google has moved the free tier of Gemini CLI to its Antigravity CLI.
